intro: Taiwan is a mountainous island about 390 km long, crossed by the Tropic of Cancer.

chapters.title: Mountains and plains
text: The Central Mountain Range runs down the east, and Yushan (Jade Mountain), 3,952 m, is the island's highest peak, higher than Mount Fuji. Most people live on the western plains.
Taroko Gorge cuts through marble cliffs.

chapters.title: Typhoons and earthquakes
text: Taiwan sits where tectonic plates meet, so earthquakes are frequent. Typhoons hit in summer and autumn.
